clone.tool: CLONE LOCAL DATA DIRECTORY + START REPLICA UNTIL SQL_BEFORE_GTIDS
clone.notes: clone plugin physical hot copy (no external tool), scratch instance replays the source binlog with GTID auto-positioning and stops before the bad transaction

steps.name: prepare
steps.out: Defaulted container "source" out of: source, init-volumes-init (init)

steps.name: clone status
steps.cmd: SELECT state, error_no, gtid_executed FROM performance_schema.clone_status

steps.name: START REPLICA UNTIL SQL_BEFORE_GTIDS
steps.cmd: CHANGE REPLICATION SOURCE TO SOURCE_HOST='source', SOURCE_PORT=3306, SOURCE_USER='repl', SOURCE_PASSWORD='replpass', SOURCE_AUTO_POSITION=1, GET_SOURCE_PUBLIC_KEY=1; START REPLICA UNTIL SQL_BEFORE_GTIDS='8a6e09f8-b037-11f1-8110-1e04fb0abcd0:150'

clone.description: clone-plugin physical copy started in a scratch container, PITR by GTID replication
